stories.headline: Daiki Hashimoto wins the world all-around gymnastics title
stories.summary: Daiki Hashimoto has won the men's individual all-around gold at the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Rotterdam. He also led the Japanese team to the team gold. The championships are being held from 17 to 25 October, with 452 gymnasts from 82 nations taking part.

stories.headline: Canada and Turkey open free trade talks
stories.summary: Canada and Turkey have begun negotiations for a free trade agreement. The talks opened in October 2026 during a visit to Ankara by the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney. The two countries have maintained diplomatic relations since 1943, and trade between them totalled US$2.4 billion in 2019.

stories.headline: Two cassowary eggs at Adelaide Zoo, the first in decades
stories.summary: A female southern cassowary has laid two bright green eggs at Adelaide Zoo in South Australia, the first laid there in more than three decades. Keepers say it has been 34 years since the zoo last had successful cassowary chicks. The eggs arrived after she was paired with a potential mate.
